authorization: One additional finite Owner-authorized final S3-F03/F06 checkpoint; previous checkpoint preserved; Antigravity 2/2 not reset.

mandatory_contract_preservation.basis: Entry file reconstructed from recorded status prefix plus unchanged current contract body; complete original bytes match the independently captured entry SHA-256. No historical table expectation changed.

prior_precheck.cause: FileNotFoundError: untracked matrix had entry hash but no entry-source physical copy; exact reconstruction now verified.

integration-resource-measurements.json.cause: Numeric PID lineage did not constrain child creation to the identified parent lifetime. V3 concretely included pre-existing OneDrive/system processes through PID reuse. Raw values are historical and are not corrected in place.

integration-resource-measurements-v2.jso.cause: Numeric PID lineage did not constrain child creation to the identified parent lifetime. V3 concretely included pre-existing OneDrive/system processes through PID reuse. Raw values are historical and are not corrected in place.

integration-resource-measurements-v3.jso.cause: Numeric PID lineage did not constrain child creation to the identified parent lifetime. V3 concretely included pre-existing OneDrive/system processes through PID reuse. Raw values are historical and are not corrected in place.

evidence_disposition.rule: Retained handles keyed by PID/creation FILETIME; child creation within parent lifetime; complete final selection rerun; no unrelated process terminated.

final_execution.artifact_selection: Filesystem write times within actual final Maven execution; files are uniquely named and never overwritten.

resources.identity_rule: Child creation must lie within the identified parent lifetime; retained handles and (PID,creation FILETIME) distinguish reuse.
limitations: 50ms sampling can miss very short processes and disk peaks; OS per-process peak working set is retained where a handle was acquired.
Host headroom is machine-wide. NVML is device-wide, not attributable worker VRAM. CUDA is not an available ONNX provider.
Temporary tree includes owned JUnit, Testcontainers and native-library fixture files; managed revision storage is reported separately.
This selection measures actual native integration cases; it is not the deferred Slice 4 comprehensive maximum workload profile.

resource_interpretation.identity_rule: Child creation must lie within the identified parent lifetime; retained handles and (PID,creation FILETIME) distinguish reuse.
resource_interpretation.qualification: Final v4 observer uses retained handles and parent lifetime/creation bounds, not persistent numeric PID membership. V1-v3 profiles are INVALID for resource acceptance because PID reuse could include pre-existing processes; raw receipts remain preserved.

native_resource_identity_coverage.qualification: Two candidate PIDs could not be identified before exit; no creation time/peak/CPU is invented. They are not bound producer/verifier identities. CPU totals and memory/disk peaks remain measured/sampled quantities, with stated short-process limitations.

retained_D14.finding: Invalid worker batch result provenance at RagEngineClient.triggerBoundWorkerBatch; inner worker exception not established from that log.

limitations: Original Antigravity S3 pre-repair stdout remains missing; do not infer its cause from a receipt exit code.

First java-resource-final outer wrapper returned 0 because its runner did not propagate the child exit; java-current-final is FAILED, 236/0/1/0. The old resource exit is orchestration status only. Later runner and resource receipts use the actual bounded Maven exit.

Only new captures contain independently bound lexical suffix hashes. Existing basename-only proofs remain valid for basename/alias use and pending updates; absent historical directory names are never guessed or silently backfilled.
Writer/seal SQL interleavings use actual native output with test-only administrative reset, real restricted worker connections and real physical commit; they are not synthetic-vector positives.
Unavailable DB injection denies all runtime proxy connections while a separate admin observer remains reachable. It does not claim a machine-wide PostgreSQL outage.

Resource profiles v1-v3 are INVALID for resource acceptance: a numeric-PID lineage observer could follow reused parent IDs into pre-existing processes. Final v4 validates child creation within the identified parent lifetime and retains handles; prior profiles remain unmodified. OS memory sampling, host headroom, device-wide VRAM and actual temporary disk are distinct.
No new human adjudication, independent acceptance, full backend clean verification, Slice 4 or P18-FINAL is claimed.
